sections.heading: High-value purchases
sections.text: Purchases above $3,000.00 require an itemized receipt and human review before any ledger change.

sections.heading: Possible duplicate charges
sections.text: Charges with the same merchant and amount posted within ten minutes are possible duplicates. An analyst must compare transaction evidence and obtain human approval before reversal or any ledger change.

sections.heading: Subscription renewal variance
sections.text: A software or subscription renewal more than twenty percent above its prior charge requires owner verification and contract evidence before approval.

sections.heading: Reimbursement documentation
sections.text: Employees must submit reimbursements within thirty days. An itemized receipt is required for expenses above $75.00.

sections.heading: Travel exceptions
sections.text: Airfare changes and hotel exceptions require the business purpose, traveler name, and manager approval to be attached to the expense.

sections.heading: Unmatched transaction review
sections.text: Unmatched bank transactions older than five business days must be assigned to an owner and documented before the monthly close is certified.

sections.heading: Evidence retention
sections.text: Approval evidence, receipts, and reconciliation records must be retained for seven years after the close period.
